name: swatch
title: Swatch
description: A color to look at or to pick, as a disc with a finished edge.
use: A color shown beside its name, or one of a few colors to pick as a label around a native radio or checkbox. Set the color with --swatch.

instead.when: The reader picks any color from the platform's picker

keyboard.action: Move the choice along radio swatches that share a name
Toggles a checkbox swatch, as the native input does

classes.name: swatch
classes.description: The disc, 24px wide: a label around a swatch-input, or a plain mark

classes.name: swatch-input
classes.description: The radio or checkbox inside a swatch; it covers the disc invisibly and needs a name, since a color has no text

classes.name: swatch-square
classes.description: A tile with a chip's corner, for a palette or a token table

states.name: checked
states.description: The swatch stands in a ring of ink, a 2px gap away, cut in the color of the surface it sits on

properties.name: --swatch
properties.description: The color, or any background image
